                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文结合uiautomation、OpenCV、EasyOCR等库的使用，对PC上微信的自动化操作进行了探讨，并在文章最后给出了一个简单的示例程序。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>1 背景</h1>
<p>随着PC微信版本不断升级（尤其 4.x 之后），传统UIAutomation控件树自动化方案逐渐失效，新版微信大量采用跨平台自绘 UI（Canvas渲染，类似Electron/Skia/Qt 思路），此时整个窗口就像一张canvas，所有按钮/输入框都是画出来的，而不是系统控件，这导致：</p>
<ul>
<li>Inspect.exe 无法查看内部控件</li>
<li>pywinauto / uiautomation 无法直接定位按钮</li>
<li>自动化脚本稳定性下降</li>
</ul>
<p>而且微信出于群控灰产、批量营销、自主商业等目的，在主动反自动化可能会进一步加强，出于合法合规的考虑，当前可靠的自动化技术路线是：窗口控制 + 截图 + 模板匹配 + OCR + 鼠标键盘模拟，即完全模拟人工操作，在AI大模型日益成熟的今天，这种技术路线也必将越来越成熟。本文结合实际工程经验，介绍如何使用：</p>
<ul>
<li>uiautomation</li>
<li>OpenCV</li>
<li>EasyOCR</li>
</ul>
<p>本文抛砖引玉，实现一个相对稳定的微信窗口自动化框架。</p>
<h1>2 环境准备</h1>
<p>首先需要安装python环境以及必要的依赖库，python安装可自行参考网络资源，版本这里使用的是Python 3.11.9，依赖库安装如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">pip install uiautomation
pip install opencv</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">python
pip install pillow
pip install numpy
pip install easyocr</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在python项目中，如果程序运行过程中提示缺少模块，直接问豆包等AI工具都会直接告诉你如何安装相应库。</p>
<h1>3 关键库介绍</h1>
<h2>3.1&nbsp;uiautomation</h2>
<p>uiautomation是Python中基于Microsoft UI Automation框架的强大库，用于实现Windows应用程序的自动化操作、软件测试和辅助工具开发，可从项目<a href="https://github.com/yinkaisheng/Python-UIAutomation-for-Windows" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">github主页</a>获取更多内容及Demo示例，以下对其使用进行简单介绍。</p>
<h3>1 基础操作方法</h3>
<p>（1）鼠标点击</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import uiautomation <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uia
# 绝对坐标点击
uia.Click(x</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>, y=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
# 控件相对点击
button </span>= uia.ButtonControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">确定</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
button.Click(ratioX</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.5</span>, ratioY=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.5</span>)  # 点击控件中心</pre>
</div>
<p>（2）键盘输入</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 文本输入
uia.SendKeys(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello World</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
# 快捷键模拟
uia.SendKeys(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{Ctrl}c</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)  # 复制操作</pre>
</div>
<h3>2&nbsp;窗口管理方法</h3>
<p>（1）窗口显示控制</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>window = uia.WindowControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">记事本</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口状态设置</span>
uia.ShowWindow(window.NativeWindowHandle, 1)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最大化</span>
uia.ShowWindow(window.NativeWindowHandle, 2)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最小化</span></pre>
</div>
<p>（2）窗口等待机制</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>wcwin = uia.WindowControl(searchDepth=1, Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">微信</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> wcwin.Exists(3, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发现微信，并将激活微信窗口</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>Exists函数两个参数可以理解为：“在指定的时间内，按固定的频率反复查找窗口”。第 0 秒立即查找一次，如果发现微信窗口，直接返回True，程序继续；第1，2秒没找到则歇1秒，再查一次；第3秒最后查一次，如果还是没找到，返回 False。直接调用Exists()而不传任何参数，它的默认行为是：立即查找并返回，不进行任何循环等待。</p>
<h3>3&nbsp;控件模式与高级操作</h3>
<p>（1）InvokePattern（激活控件）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uiautomation as uia

button </span>= uia.ButtonControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">确定</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
button.GetInvokePattern().Invoke()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>uia.ButtonControl(Name='确定') (定位规则)</p>
<p>这一行并不立即执行查找，它只是创建了一个“搜索描述符”。它告诉程序：我要找一个类型是Button（按钮）、名字叫“确定”的控件。</p>
<p>button.GetInvokePattern() (获取模式)</p>
<p>这是UI Automation (UIA) 标准的核心，UIA将控件的能力抽象为“模式”，InvokePattern专门用于处理类似“点击”的触发动作。</p>
<p>.Invoke() (执行动作)</p>
<p>这才是真正的执行指令，程序会顺着之前的描述符去桌面的UI树里搜寻，一旦找到匹配的第一个对象，就向它发送一个“触发”指令。如下图中工具Inspect给出了桌面UI树：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202603/465567-20260318101211601-1505876463.png" alt="image" width="722" height="533" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>示例代码中那样直接通过uia.ButtonControl定义，它默认会在全桌面范围内搜索，这非常危险，因为它可能会点到任务栏、后台程序或者其他无关窗口的“确定”按钮。实际代码中一般会限定范围，如在窗口内部查找：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uiautomation as uia

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 先定位目标窗口</span>
window = uia.WindowControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">记事本</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 或 ClassName="Notepad"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 再在【这个窗口内部】找“确定”</span>
button = window.ButtonControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">确定</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
button.GetInvokePattern().Invoke()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>如果一个窗口里有多个“确定”，还可以用foundIndex指定哪一个：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第一个确定</span>
button1 = window.ButtonControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">确定</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, foundIndex=1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第二个确定</span>
button2 = window.ButtonControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">确定</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, foundIndex=2)</pre>
</div>
<p>（2）ValuePattern（值操作）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>edit = uia.EditControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">输入框</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取值</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(edit.GetValuePattern().Value)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置值</span>
edit.GetValuePattern().SetValue(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">New Text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>（3）SelectionPattern（选择控制）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>combo = uia.ComboBoxControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">下拉框</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
selected_items </span>= combo.GetSelectionPattern().GetSelection()</pre>
</div>
<h3>4&nbsp;上下文管理器</h3>
<p>（1）线程安全初始化</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">with uia.UIAutomationInitializerInThread():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 确保COM环境正确初始化</span>
    main_window = uia.WindowControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">主窗口</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    main_window.SetActive()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在这个代码块里，初始化线程的 UIAutomation 环境，然后安全地操作窗口。为当前线程初始化Windows COM组件环境，UIAutomation底层依赖Windows COM接口，主线程会自动初始化，子线程/多线程必须手动初始化，不写会直接报错：RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE、访问冲突、调用失败，即只要在子线程/多线程里用uiautomation，外面必须包这一句。</p>
<h3>5&nbsp;控件属性与定位</h3>
<p>（1）常用控件属性</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202603/465567-20260318102032394-1526942519.png" alt="image" width="606" height="133" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>（2）控件定位方法</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 通过名称定位</span>
button = uia.ButtonControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">确定</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 通过自动化ID定位</span>
edit = uia.EditControl(AutomationId=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">txtInput</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 层级遍历定位</span>
root =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uia.GetRootControl()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> child <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> root.GetChildren():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> child.ControlTypeName == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Window</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(child.Name)</pre>
</div>
<h3>6&nbsp;异常处理与优化</h3>
<p>（1）控件不可见处理</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>target = uia.ButtonControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">隐藏按钮</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> target.Exists():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> target.IsOffscreen:
        target.SendKeys(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{PageDown}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 滚动显示</span>
    target.Click()</pre>
</div>
<p>（2）超时异常处理</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> _ <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        window </span>= uia.WindowControl(Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">延迟窗口</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> window.Exists(1):  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1秒超时</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            window.Click()
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">操作失败: {e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h2>3.2&nbsp;easyocr</h2>
<h3>1 原理</h3>
<p>EasyOCR原理简单：先找文字在哪里，再把文字读出来，流程两大核心步骤：</p>
<p>（1）文字检测（Detection）</p>
<p>作用：在图片里找到所有文字区域，画框框住</p>
<p>底层算法：CRAFT，会分析图片每个像素，以确定这里像不像文字？之后把连续的文字连成一个矩形框</p>
<p>输出：一堆文字框坐标。</p>
<p>（2）文字识别（Recognition）</p>
<p>作用：把每个框里的图像变成真正的文字<br>底层算法：CRNN，把小图输入深度学习模型<br>输出：文字内容 + 可信度（conf）</p>
<p>完整流程如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">图片输入
   ↓
【预处理】调整大小、灰度、对比度
   ↓
【文字检测】找到所有文字区域（CRAFT）
   ↓
【切割小图】把每个文字区域切出来
   ↓
【文字识别】把小图变成文字（CRNN）
   ↓
【输出结果】坐标 </span>+ 文字 + 可信度</pre>
</div>
<h3>2 技术优势</h3>
<p>PyTorch —— 运行深度学习模型</p>
<p>CRAFT —— 找文字位置</p>
<p>CRNN —— 图像转文字</p>
<p>CRAFT对不规则文字、小文字、倾斜文字检测很稳，CRNN专门做端到端文字识别，训练数据包含大量屏幕文字、UI文字、海报文字，所以相比传统工具它具有无可比拟的优势，下面拿它和Tesseract进行对比。</p>
<p>首先给出结论：90%的场景下，EasyOCR效果 &gt; Tesseract，特定场景（纯文档、印刷体、长文本）Tesseract更好。</p>
<p>以下是核心对比：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202603/465567-20260318105411915-1504081986.png" alt="image" width="476" height="303" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>&nbsp;所以，EasyOCR适合桌面自动化、截图识别、UI 文字读取（拍照/截图/UI界面），而Tesseract适合OCR文字大量提取、文档类识别（文档/扫描件）。</p>
<h3>3 使用示例</h3>
<p>（1）无参数</p>
<p>适用于只想提取文字，不想看坐标。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> easyocr

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 创建 reader，指定语言，中文+英文</span>
reader = easyocr.Reader([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ch_sim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">en</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 读取图片文字</span>
result = reader.readtext(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 输出结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> bbox, text, conf <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文字：{text}，可信度：{conf:.2f}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>（2）带常用参数</p>
<p>适用于既要文字识别，又要文字坐标。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> reader.readtext(
    image_path,       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图片路径</span>
    text_threshold=0.3,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文字识别置信度（低=更容易识别，但可能错）</span>
    low_text=0.3,     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文字区域灵敏度（低=能识别淡字）</span>
    detail=1          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1=返回坐标+文字+置信度 0=只返回文字</span>
)</pre>
</div>
<p>返回内容格式如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[
   [ [x1,y1], [x2,y1], [x2,y2], [x1,y2] ],  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">文字内容</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,  可信度
]</span></pre>
</div>
<p>bbox：文字的四个角坐标</p>
<p>text：识别出来的文字</p>
<p>conf：可信度（0~1）</p>
<p>（3）支持语言</p>
<p>ch_sim：简体中文，ch_tra：繁体中文，en：英文，ja：日文，ko：韩文</p>
<p>（4）UI自动化、截图识别推荐参数</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> reader.readtext(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">screenshot.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    text_threshold</span>=0.2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    low_text</span>=0.2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    detail</span>=1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)</span></pre>
</div>
<p>灵敏度最高，适合界面文字、按钮文字、小文字。</p>
<h1>4 示例程序</h1>
<h2>4.1&nbsp;模板匹配（OpenCV）</h2>
<p>模板匹配通俗来讲就是拿着一张小图（模板），在大图里到处滑动对比，找一模一样/最相似的位置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.matchTemplate(img, template, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 获取最大值、最小值 + 坐标</span>
min_val, max_val, min_loc, max_loc =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.minMaxLoc(result)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 匹配度最高的点就是 max_loc</span>
best_x, best_y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> max_loc
best_score </span>= max_val  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最高匹配分数</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 设置阈值判断是否有效</span>
threshold = 0.8
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> best_score &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> threshold:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">找到匹配最高的目标：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, best_x, best_y, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">分数：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, best_score)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到有效匹配</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>代码中tempate是模板图片，img是要进行匹配的大图，这里会使用TM_CCOEFF_NORMED算法进行匹配，并根据阈值找到最大的匹配值。进行模板匹配时，模板图片要提前准备好，并且匹配结果坐标是在大图中的位置，还需根据实际情况，确定是否转换为在整个桌面的位置。</p>
<h2>4.2 鼠标拖动</h2>
<p>鼠标拖动首先需要确定拖动的起始和结束位置，然后还需要给出多长时间内分几次完成拖动，整个过程就是移动到起始位，按下鼠标左键，分步拖动，抬起左键，整个示例代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> mouse_drag(start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, duration=0.5, steps=20<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    模拟鼠标左键拖动
    start_x, start_y: 起点屏幕坐标
    end_x, end_y: 终点屏幕坐标
    duration: 拖动总耗时
    steps: 拖动分多少步
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模拟鼠标拖动({},{})-&gt;({},{})</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.format(start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y))
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 移动到起点</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    user32.SetCursorPos(int(start_x), int(start_y))
    time.sleep(</span>0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按下左键</span>
    user32.mouse_event(2, 0, 0, 0, 0)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN</span>
    time.sleep(0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拖动</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(1, steps + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        x </span>= int(start_x + (end_x - start_x) * i /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> steps)
        y </span>= int(start_y + (end_y - start_y) * i /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> steps)
        user32.SetCursorPos(x, y)
        time.sleep(duration </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> steps)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 抬起左键</span>
    user32.mouse_event(4, 0, 0, 0, 0)</pre>
</div>
<h2>4.3 完整代码</h2>
<p>以下代码给出了操作微信的简单示例，在例子中会根据名称在联系人列表中查找该联系人，找到联系人后对其选中并发送消息“你好”，之后再通过模拟鼠标拖动滚动轮查看历史消息，完整代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_03ba33e9-c62d-48c0-91fd-a11345733354" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_03ba33e9-c62d-48c0-91fd-a11345733354" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_03ba33e9-c62d-48c0-91fd-a11345733354" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> uiautomation as uia
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os, sys
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> math

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numpy as np
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> PIL <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ImageGrab
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> easyocr
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ⭐ DPI 修正（非常重要）</span>
ctypes.windll.shcore.SetProcessDpiAwareness(2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

user32 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ctypes.windll.user32

screen_h </span>= user32.GetSystemMetrics(1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">屏幕分辨率: {screen_w}x{screen_h}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">加载easyocr</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
reader </span>= easyocr.Reader([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ch_sim</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">en</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>], gpu=False, verbose=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TempMatch(tempName):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ⭐ 截图窗口</span>
    img_pil = ImageGrab.grab(bbox=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(wcleft, wctop, wcright, wcbottom))
    img </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.cvtColor(np.array(img_pil), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ⭐ 读取模板图标</span>
    template =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.imread(tempName)
    h, w </span>= template.shape[:2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ⭐ 模板匹配</span>
    result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.matchTemplate(img, template, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
    threshold </span>= 0.8<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    found </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> False
    screen_x </span>= screen_y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    loc = np.where(result &gt;= threshold)
    for pt in zip(*loc[::-1]):
        found = True
        # ⭐ 图标在窗口中的位置
        icon_x = pt[0]
        icon_y = pt[1]
        # ⭐ 转换为桌面坐标
        screen_x = int(wcleft + icon_x + w // 2)
        screen_y = int(wctop + icon_y + h // 2)
        print("发现图标："+tempName)
        print("图标窗口位置:", icon_x, icon_y)
        print("图标桌面位置:", screen_x, screen_y)
        # ⭐ 画框显示
        cv2.rectangle(img, pt, (pt[0] + w, pt[1] + h), (0, 0, 255), 2)
        cv2.imwrite("match_result.png", img)
        break
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 获取最大值、最小值 + 坐标</span>
    min_val, max_val, min_loc, max_loc =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.minMaxLoc(result)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 匹配度最高的点就是 max_loc</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">best_x, best_y = max_loc</span>
    best_score = max_val  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最高匹配分数</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 设置阈值判断是否有效</span>
    threshold = 0.8
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> best_score &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> threshold:
        found </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True
        icon_x, icon_y </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> max_loc
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ⭐ 转换为桌面坐标</span>
        screen_x = int(wcleft + icon_x + w // 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        screen_y </span>= int(wctop + icon_y + h // 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发现图标：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tempName)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">图标窗口位置:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, icon_x, icon_y)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">图标桌面位置:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, screen_x, screen_y)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ⭐ 画框显示</span>
        cv2.rectangle(img, (icon_x, icon_y), (icon_x + w, icon_y + h), (0, 0, 255), 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        cv2.imwrite(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">match_result.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, img)
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> found, screen_x, screen_y

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> mouse_drag(start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, duration=0.5, steps=20<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
    模拟鼠标左键拖动
    start_x, start_y: 起点屏幕坐标
    end_x, end_y: 终点屏幕坐标
    duration: 拖动总耗时
    steps: 拖动分多少步
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模拟鼠标拖动({},{})-&gt;({},{})</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.format(start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y))
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 移动到起点</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    user32.SetCursorPos(int(start_x), int(start_y))
    time.sleep(</span>0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 按下左键</span>
    user32.mouse_event(2, 0, 0, 0, 0)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN</span>
    time.sleep(0.1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 拖动</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(1, steps + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        x </span>= int(start_x + (end_x - start_x) * i /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> steps)
        y </span>= int(start_y + (end_y - start_y) * i /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> steps)
        user32.SetCursorPos(x, y)
        time.sleep(duration </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> steps)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 抬起左键</span>
    user32.mouse_event(4<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, 0, 0, 0, 0)

wcwin </span>= uia.WindowControl(searchDepth=1, Name=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">微信</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> wcwin.Exists(3, 1):      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第0，1，2，3秒分别查看窗口是否存在，只要存在返回True继续</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发现微信，并将激活微信窗口</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    wcwin.SetActive()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">wcwin.SetTopmost(True)</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ⭐ 获取窗口桌面位置</span>
    wcwin.CaptureToImage(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wcMain.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    rect </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> wcwin.BoundingRectangle

    wcleft, wctop, wcright, wcbottom </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rect.left, rect.top, rect.right, rect.bottom
    wcwidth, wcheight </span>= wcright - wcleft, wcbottom -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> wctop
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">微信窗口位置: {wcleft},{wctop},{wcwidth},{wcheight}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    template_path </span>= os.path.join(BASE_DIR, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">contact.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    found, screen_x, screen_y </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TempMatch(template_path)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> found:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到图标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        uia.Click(screen_x, screen_y)
        wcwin.CaptureToImage(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wcWnd.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 扫描完整截图</span>
        result = reader.readtext(r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wcWnd.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, text_threshold=0.3, low_text=0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        search_x </span>= search_y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=== ALL TEXT (low threshold) ===</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> detection <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result:
            bbox, text, conf </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detection
            cx </span>= int((bbox[0][0] + bbox[2][0]) / 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            cy </span>= int((bbox[0][1] + bbox[2][1]) / 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">({cx:4d},{cy:4d}) {text} [{conf:.2f}]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> text.find(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">搜</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) != -1 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> text.find(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">索</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) != -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                search_x, search_y </span>= wcleft+cx, wctop+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cy
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">找到搜索框</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> search_x &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">单击搜索框，并发送联系人名称</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            uia.Click(search_x, search_y)
            uia.SendKeys(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ZWW</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            time.sleep(</span>0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            wcwin.CaptureToImage(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wcWnd.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 扫描完整截图</span>
            result = reader.readtext(r<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wcWnd.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, text_threshold=0.3, low_text=0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            search_x </span>= search_y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">print('=== ALL TEXT (low threshold) ===')</span>
            findIdx =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> detection <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result:
                bbox, text, conf </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> detection
                cx </span>= int((bbox[0][0] + bbox[2][0]) / 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                cy </span>= int((bbox[0][1] + bbox[2][1]) / 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">({cx:4d},{cy:4d}) {text} [{conf:.2f}]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> text.find(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Z</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) != -1 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> text.find(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">W</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) != -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                    findIdx </span>+= 1
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> findIdx &gt; 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                        search_x, search_y </span>= wcleft+cx, wctop+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cy
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> search_x &gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">发现联系人，单击，并发送'你好'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                uia.Click(search_x, search_y)
                uia.SendKeys(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你好</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                uia.SendKeys(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{Enter}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">移动鼠标到微信窗口中间位置</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> move to the center of wechat</span>
        user32.SetCursorPos(wcleft+wcwidth//2, wctop+wcheight//2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        template_path </span>= os.path.join(BASE_DIR, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dragdown.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        found, screen_x, screen_y </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TempMatch(template_path)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> found:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到图标</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">拖动滚动条</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最新版微信不最右侧的拖动条很敏感，一不小心就成修改窗口尺寸了，所以这里-3，尽量远离边框</span>
            mouse_drag(screen_x-3, screen_y, screen_x-3, wctop, 2, 30<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">微信未发现</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">View Code</span></div>
<p>程序运行需要自行制作用于微信主界面匹配的模板文件：contact.png和dragdown.png，使用任意截图文件在微信主界面进行截图就可以制作相应文件。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202603/465567-20260320113447265-1575597952.png" alt="image" width="1035" height="222" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>程序运行效果图如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202603/465567-20260320114145450-596483699.gif" alt="1" width="981" height="366" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h2>4.4 补充说明</h2>
<p>以上程序只是给出简单的示例程序，要想真正的做好微信自动化工具，还有很多细节需要考虑，比如利用opencv的线段检测可以把各个功能区进行详细划分，这样在进行相关操作时，需要在相应的功能区进行，提高模板匹配或文字识别的精度。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numpy as np

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 读取图片</span>
img = cv2.imread(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wcMain.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 转灰度图</span>
gray =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 边缘检测（必须！霍夫变换需要边缘图）</span>
edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 30, 120<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 线段检测（核心函数）</span>
lines =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cv2.HoughLinesP(
    edges,          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 边缘图</span>
    1,              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 半径精度, 1 个像素，适合绝大多数场景，速度快、精度够；2 个像素，速度更快，但检测会更粗糙。</span>
    np.pi/180,      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 角度精度</span>
    threshold=50,   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 阈值，越高检测越少</span>
    minLineLength=150,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最小线段长度50</span>
    maxLineGap=6      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最大间断间隔</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 把线段画在图上</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> lines <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{} lines detected</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.format(len(lines)))
    lineColor </span>= 255
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> line <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lines:
        x1, y1, x2, y2 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> line[0]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(%d,%d) (%d,%d)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(x1, y1, x2, y2))
        cv2.line(img, (x1,y1), (x2,y2), (0,0,lineColor), </span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        lineColor </span>-= 10
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> lineColor &lt; 50<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            lineColor </span>= 50
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">no line detected</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 显示结果</span>
cv2.imshow(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">edges</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, edges)
cv2.imshow(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, img)
cv2.waitKey(0)</span></pre>
</div>
<p>通过调整检测参数，利用检测出来的直线对主界面进行功能区划分：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202603/465567-20260320114949453-898730981.png" alt="image" width="1061" height="400" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>另外微信的升级还是比较频繁的，如果升级涉及到UI风格或布局的调整，之前制作的模板文件等都需要做相应的调整修改。最后easyOcr的识别效率和精度还是比较差的，要想进行高效且精度更高的识别可能还得对相关模型进行优化或者使用相关商业库。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
